angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 886,662 km at 27.54 pc = 0.43 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 36.3115 +/- 0.0375 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 27.54 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.274 (1.249 to 1.300) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 886,662 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.111 (1.071 to 1.151) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6068 +/- 1.6 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6770313530317154560: teff_gspphot 6067.7993 K (16th-84th percentiles 6066.251-6069.3955), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6770313530317154560: teff_gspphot 6067.7993 K (16th-84th percentiles 6066.251-6069.3955), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/gumala.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.273, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 179949 (pscomppars): spectral type F8 V, from Wittenmyer et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJ...654..625W/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 179949 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.137 dex, from Butler et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006ApJ...646..505B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 179949 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.30146, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 179949 (pscomppars): age 2.56 Gyr, from Takeda et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJS..168..297T/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 179949 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 6.3 km/s, from Tinney et al. 2001 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2001ApJ...551..507T/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
